items.t: The quadrant runs from the Edmonds town centre and the Kingsway/Canada Way corridors east to the New Westminster border, taking in the Cariboo-Armstrong lands, Second Street, Twelfth Avenue and the Robert Burnaby Park lands.
Green anchor: Robert Burnaby Park — creek corridors, more than half of the park in critical wildlife habitat, a City program planting 3,000 trees, and 3 tennis plus 10 pickleball courts.

Recreation anchors: the Rosemary Brown Recreation Centre at 7789 18th Street (2 NHL-size rinks) and the Edmonds Community Centre at 7433 Edmonds Street. The quadrant's library branch is the Tommy Douglas Library.
Planning frame: the Edmonds Community Plan was adopted in March 2025 — the current plan document for the town-centre part of the quadrant.
Transit: route 116 runs Metrotown–Edmonds via 18th Avenue and Griffiths Drive.

Schools in and beside the quadrant: Second Street Community Elementary (7502 2nd Street), Twelfth Avenue Elementary (7622 12th Avenue), Taylor Park Elementary (7590 Mission Avenue) and Cariboo Hill Secondary (8580 16th Avenue). Which of these fall inside the MLS "East Burnaby" line versus the Edmonds or Cariboo lines is UNVERIFIED.
Where condo stock concentrates: the verified apartment listings for the SnapStats "East Burnaby" row are scattered singles, not a cluster —.

Streets, schools and getting around East Burnaby

items.t: East Burnaby covers Burnaby's eastern side, from the Edmonds town centre and the Kingsway / Canada Way corridors east to the City of New Westminster border, taking in the Cariboo-Armstrong streets, the Second Street and Twelfth Avenue school neighbourhoods and the Robert Burnaby Park lands. Street-by-street boundaries for the MLS sub-area: UNVERIFIED — no City source read publishes them; the confirmed anchors are Edmonds, one of Burnaby's four town centres, at the west side, the New Westminster border at the east, and Robert Burnaby Park and Cariboo Hill in between.

Nearby areas: Edmonds and Highgate to the west and south-west, Cariboo and The Crest within the east side, South Slope to the south-west, and the City of New Westminster across 10th Avenue / the eastern border.

Where the townhouse stock concentrates: not in this row — the row is detached-heavy (see the market line below), and the quadrant's named townhouse complexes sit at the Edmonds / Highgate node under the Edmonds BE sub-area filing. The attached stock inside this row itself was verified by name in the condos program as apartment form only.

Burnaby IS covered by SnapStats, but only as combined "Condos & Townhomes," never townhome-only, and medians are community-level only: Burnaby's combined median was $686,000 in September 2026 ($763/sqft, 98% sale-to-list, 36 days on market). No East Burnaby sub-area median exists.

Main roads: Canada Way, Kingsway, Edmonds Street and 10th Avenue run east–west, with 6th Street, 2nd Street and Cariboo Road running north–south. Transit: Edmonds Station (Expo Line) serves the area's west side, and route 116 runs between Metrotown Station and Edmonds Station via Imperial, Sussex, Marine Drive, Marine Way, Byrne Road, Southridge Drive, Griffiths Drive and 18th Avenue.

SD41 schools on the Province's list in or beside this broad area include Second Street Community Elementary (K–7), 7502 2nd St, Twelfth Avenue Elementary (K–7), 7622 12th Ave, Taylor Park Elementary (K–7), 7590 Mission Ave, and Cariboo Hill Secondary (8–12), 8580 16th Ave; which fall inside the MLS sub-area line versus the neighbouring Edmonds and Cariboo sub-areas is UNVERIFIED.

Parks and anchors: Robert Burnaby Park is the east side's big park — many creeks and streams run through it and over half its area is critical wildlife habitat, with a City restoration project planting 3,000 new trees. Rosemary Brown Recreation Centre, 7789 18th Street, is at the area's south side; Edmonds Community Centre, 7433 Edmonds Street, is at the west edge; the Tommy Douglas Library serves this quadrant; the Edmonds Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at #201-7315 Edmonds St, and the city's hospital is Burnaby Hospital, 3935 Kincaid St.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in East Burnaby

items.t: The diligence frame, stated plainly for a zero-count row: any townhouse a buyer actually purchases on the east side will almost always be an Edmonds BE strata purchase, so the strata package governs there: Form B Information Certificate under Strata Property Act s. 59 — monthly strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, current budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page.

Hazard check: creeks and streams run through Robert Burnaby Park and the ravine lands on the east side; a floodplain designation for East Burnaby's residential streets was not confirmed in the sources read, and parcel-level hazard, watercourse-setback and ALR status are property-specific checks — ALR status through the Agricultural Land Commission.

Property tax and utilities: City of Burnaby property taxes for 2026 were due Friday, July 3, 2026; a 5% penalty applies to outstanding current taxes (and to an unclaimed home owner grant) after the July due date, with a further 5% penalty after the September due date. There is NO Vancouver Empty Homes Tax in Burnaby — that 3% tax is Vancouver only and never applies here.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in East Burnaby

items.t: Habitat diligence: over half of Robert Burnaby Park is critical wildlife habitat and restoration work runs through it — for park- and creek-edge lots, check watercourse setbacks and the restoration project's trail closures early.

Bare-land strata rules (applies to any bare-land strata lot, including a future stratified R1 multi-unit lot): Form B diligence (fees, amounts owed, levies, CRF balance, insurance summary; provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page); depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022 (short-term restrictions may still apply by bylaw); only 55+ age bylaws valid under SPA ss.123.1/123.2, with May 1, 2023 exemptions (younger spouse/partner, caregivers, legacy residents, defined children); a listing's "45+" line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw.

ALR rules (for completeness — no East Burnaby ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR.

blocks.text: Good to know about East Burnaby

items.t: The quadrant is being replanted while you buy in it: the City's Robert Burnaby Park restoration removes invasive species and plants 3,000 new trees, with some trails and areas closed during the work — a park-edge lot's outlook and access change over the project, in the improving direction, on the City's own description.

The east side's newest plan layer is dated March 2025: the Edmonds Community Plan was officially adopted that month for the town-centre part of the quadrant, and the Burnaby 2050 OCP (adopted December 9, 2025) now takes precedence over older community-plan maps where they conflict — check both layers for a town-centre-edge lot.

The City is its own landlord at the border: the 204-home project at 10th Avenue and Newcombe Street is the Burnaby Housing Authority's application — a municipal corporation's rental project, part of a two-project announcement totalling 387 new rental homes — so the quadrant's most visible "new development" adds rental supply, not purchasable land or strata.

Page-statement check for this area. Approved page claims, where a live page states them, are the settled set only: REALTOR since 2015; 10 straight years in the FVREB Medallion Club; Top 1% of Fraser Valley Realtors; #1 in South Surrey/White Rock by MLS points for 2025 and 2026 YTD; more than $500M in sales.

faq.a: Burnaby's eastern quadrant — the residential east side between the Edmonds town centre and the New Westminster border, taking in Robert Burnaby Park, Cariboo Hill and the Second Street and Twelfth Avenue neighbourhoods; it is a GVR MLS® sub-area name, not one small neighbourhood.

faq.q: Which schools are on Burnaby's east side?
faq.a: SD41 schools on the Province's list include Second Street Community Elementary (K–7), 7502 2nd St, Twelfth Avenue Elementary (K–7), 7622 12th Ave, Taylor Park Elementary (K–7), 7590 Mission Ave, and Cariboo Hill Secondary (8–12), 8580 16th Ave; catchments are address-based and must be checked in the SD41 locator.

The east side's large forested park — the City describes many creeks and streams running through it and over half its area as critical wildlife habitat, and is restoring it with invasive-species removal and 3,000 new trees; its courts are listed at 3 tennis and 10 pickleball.

faq.q: How is transit on the east side?
faq.a: Edmonds Station on the Expo Line serves the west side of the area, and route 116 links Edmonds Station to Metrotown Station through south and east Burnaby via Griffiths Drive, Southridge Drive, 18th Avenue and Marine Way.

faq.q: Is "East Burnaby" a neighbourhood or a quadrant?
A Toscana listing says "No Pets or Rentals" — can the strata enforce that?
faq.a: Half of it. The rentals half is void: strata rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022. The pets half can still be a valid bylaw — read the registered bylaws on the Form B before assuming a pet is permitted.

faq.q: Is the big project at 10th Avenue & Newcombe Street condos I can buy?
Which schools serve a given address here?
faq.a: Second Street Community Elementary (7502 2nd Street), Twelfth Avenue Elementary (7622 12th Avenue), Taylor Park Elementary (7590 Mission Avenue) and Cariboo Hill Secondary (8580 16th Avenue) are the schools in and beside the quadrant, but which side of the MLS sub-area lines they fall on is UNVERIFIED. Burnaby School District 41 runs 41 elementary and 8 secondary schools with no middle tier (K–7 / 8–12), and catchments are address-based through the SD41 locator — run the specific address.

faq.q: What recreation is in the quadrant itself?
faq.a: Robert Burnaby Park (creeks, 3 tennis and 10 pickleball courts, more than half critical wildlife habitat), the Rosemary Brown Recreation Centre at 7789 18th Street with 2 NHL-size rinks, the Edmonds Community Centre at 7433 Edmonds Street, and the Tommy Douglas Library.

faq.q: Is a Kensington townhouse strata or freehold?
faq.a: Strata — the listing record states Ownership Type Freehold Strata, Building Type Townhouse, 22 units in development, built 1992, with pets allowed with restrictions and rentals allowed. Confirm the registered bylaws on the Form B; the rental position is in any case governed by the November 24, 2022 voiding of rental-restriction bylaws.

faq.q: Can I rent out an east-side townhouse long-term?
faq.a: Yes under provincial law: strata rental-restriction bylaws have been void since Nov 24, 2022. Short-term rentals can still be restricted by bylaw — read the registered bylaws in the Form B package.

faq.q: Which schools serve an east-side townhouse?
faq.a: Address-based in SD41 — the Province's list places Second Street Community Elementary, Twelfth Avenue Elementary, Taylor Park Elementary and Cariboo Hill Secondary in or beside the broad area, but the locator result for any specific address here is UNVERIFIED. Run the exact address in the SD41 locator before relying on a catchment.
